🎙Guglielmo #Vicario on @DAZN_IT:FEELINGS"A lot of emotion, honestly.As I have already said, for me this is a dream come true, now I have to live it with enthusiasm, humility and balance.Today is a great night for me without a doubt, and for the team, for the result obtained, because winning is never taken for granted anyway. It is what we work for, but it is never easy, because then you have to respect the opponents, they have value, they are uncomfortable, they disrupt your game. So it is a victory that we take 100%, but starting tomorrow we begin again, there is no time to rest on our laurels and just enjoy the victories.Tomorrow we already have to work toward Sunday."SAVING AFTER 60 MINUT

🎙Jhon #Lucumi on @DAZN_IT:GOOD DEBUT?"Good, very good, playing alongside great players makes things easier, I think, and we are happy because the team is working well, we are trying to be a strong team and we must continue like this"#SPALLETTI"Good, I think the team has done a great job, together we achieved a clean sheet.We hope to continue like this, working like this, with #Spalletti we are all improving and reaching our maximum level."#Juventus #Juve[@PuebloJ]
